review:
Verdict: Approved with minor text adjustments. Complies with locked facts. No fake claims.

Language Issues:

1. Image register clash. Line 2 use polite diminutive ("ပြေစာပုံလေး ပို့လိုက်ပါ"), lines 3 and 5 switch to casual speech ("စစ်ပေးမယ်", "ရမယ်").
Replacement:
"ပြေစာပုံ ပို့လိုက်ပါ"
"AI က စစ်ပေးပြီး"
"အတည်ပြုတာနဲ့"
"Key ရပါမယ်"

2. Translationese in caption paragraph 2. "အတည်ပြုနိုင်တာနဲ့" mirror English "as soon as it can verify". Awkward native flow.
Replacement: Change to "စစ်ဆေးအတည်ပြုပြီးတာနဲ့".

3. Cutesy suffix in Line 2 image. "ပြေစာပုံလေး" too soft for adult utility tool.
Replacement: Drop "လေး", use "ပြေစာပုံ" or "ငွေလွှဲပြေစာ".

Score: 8.5/10
